<!--
================================================================================
  GOAL
  ----
  Apply standard K-Means clustering to user embedding vectors from the
  MovieLens 1M dataset, available at three dimensionalities (64, 128, 256).
  Three K-Means algorithms (Hartigan-Wong, Lloyd, MacQueen) are evaluated
  across k = 2:20 using three complementary criteria — WSS (elbow method),
  Average Silhouette Width, and Calinski-Harabasz index — to select the best
  number of clusters. The final model uses MacQueen with the elbow-selected k,
  and all results are saved for downstream comparison.

  HOW IT WORKS
  ------------
  1. Setup        – Load libraries, create output directories, define embedding
                    paths and the k range to evaluate.
  2. Load helper  – load_kmeans_cached_results() reconstructs a full result
                    object from per-algorithm cache files, used when the
                    full-result cache is absent.
  3. Eval helpers – evaluate_kmeans() fits one algorithm across all k values
                    and returns WSS, Silhouette, and CH metrics per k.
                    find_elbow_k() identifies the elbow of the WSS curve
                    using the maximum perpendicular distance method.
  4. Select k     – MacQueen results are used as the primary source; the elbow
                    k is selected as final_k, with Silhouette and CH as
                    supporting diagnostics.
  5. Final fit    – A high-quality final k-means model is re-fitted with
                    nstart = 100 on MacQueen to reduce sensitivity to
                    random initialisation.
  6. Visualize    – Plot Silhouette, CH, and WSS (with elbow marker) by k for
                    all three algorithms, plus PCA projections of the final
                    cluster assignments.
  7. Save         – Write cluster assignment CSVs, metric CSVs, and serialised
                    model objects (.rds) for each embedding.
================================================================================
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
```

# Overview

# 1. Requirements
```{r libraries}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2",
  "cluster",     # silhouette()
  "clusterCrit", # intCriteria() for Calinski-Harabasz
  "factoextra"   # fviz_* helpers
)

installed    <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
library(clusterCrit)
library(factoextra)
```

# 2. Load embeddings files
```{r download-and-read}
# Paths to the three pre-computed user embedding CSV files
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

# Range of k values to evaluate for each embedding
k_vals      <- 2:20
all_results <- list()

# Create output directories upfront so write steps never fail
dir.create("output/kmeans_plots",   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/kmeans_cache",   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/kmeans_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 3. Choose Number of Clusters
```{r load-saved}
# Reconstruct a full result object from per-algorithm cache files.
# Used as a fallback when the full-result cache is absent but individual
# algorithm results have already been saved.
# Returns NULL if required cache files are missing.
load_kmeans_cached_results <- function(embedding_path) {
  embeddings       <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  user_ids         <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embeddings[, -1]))
  embedding_tag    <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  # If the full-result cache exists, use it directly
  full_file <- file.path(
    "output/kmeans_cache",
    paste0("kmeans_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )
  if (file.exists(full_file)) return(readRDS(full_file))

  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  # Cache file paths for each algorithm and the combined results
  kmeans_file <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("kmeans_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))
  all_file    <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_all_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))
  mq_file     <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_mq_",  embedding_tag, ".rds"))
  hw_file     <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_hw_",  embedding_tag, ".rds"))
  lloyd_file  <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_lloyd_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))

  # All three core files must exist to reconstruct a valid result
  if (!file.exists(kmeans_file) || !file.exists(all_file) || !file.exists(mq_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  kmeans_result <- readRDS(kmeans_file)
  k_results_all <- readRDS(all_file)
  k_results_mq  <- readRDS(mq_file)

  # HW and Lloyd results are optional (may not have been saved in older runs)
  k_results_hw    <- if (file.exists(hw_file))    readRDS(hw_file)    else NULL
  k_results_lloyd <- if (file.exists(lloyd_file)) readRDS(lloyd_file) else NULL

  # Select best k from MacQueen metrics
  best_k_sil   <- k_results_mq$k[which.max(k_results_mq$Silhouette)]
  best_k_ch    <- k_results_mq$k[which.max(k_results_mq$CH)]
  elbow_info   <- find_elbow_k(k_results_mq$k, k_results_mq$WSS)
  best_k_elbow <- elbow_info$elbow_k
  final_k      <- nrow(kmeans_result$centers)

  cluster_df    <- data.frame(UserID = user_ids, Cluster = kmeans_result$cluster)
  final_sil     <- silhouette(kmeans_result$cluster, dmat)
  final_avg_sil <- mean(final_sil[, 3])

  # PCA projection for visualisation
  pca           <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)
  )

  list(
    embedding_path  = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag   = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids        = user_ids,
    dmat            = dmat,
    k_results_hw    = k_results_hw,
    k_results_lloyd = k_results_lloyd,
    k_results_mq    = k_results_mq,
    k_results_all   = k_results_all,
    best_k_sil      = best_k_sil,
    best_k_ch       = best_k_ch,
    best_k_elbow    = best_k_elbow,
    elbow_distances = elbow_info$distances,
    final_k         = final_k,
    kmeans_result   = kmeans_result,
    cluster_df      = cluster_df,
    final_sil       = final_sil,
    final_avg_sil   = final_avg_sil,
    pca_df          = pca_df,
    var_explained   = var_explained
  )
}
```


```{r eval-funct}
# ── Evaluation helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Fit one k-means algorithm across all k values and return metrics + models.
# For each k, records:
#   WSS        – total within-cluster sum of squares (elbow method)
#   Silhouette – average silhouette width
#   CH         – Calinski-Harabasz index
# Errors and warnings are caught per-k so one failure does not abort the loop.
evaluate_kmeans <- function(x, k_vals, dmat, algorithm = "Hartigan-Wong",
                            nstart = 10, iter.max = 100) {

  wss         <- numeric(length(k_vals))
  sil_scores  <- numeric(length(k_vals))
  ch_scores   <- numeric(length(k_vals))
  runtime_sec <- numeric(length(k_vals))
  status      <- rep("ok", length(k_vals))
  notes       <- rep(NA_character_, length(k_vals))
  models      <- vector("list", length(k_vals))

  for (i in seq_along(k_vals)) {
    k  <- k_vals[i]
    t0 <- Sys.time()

    km <- tryCatch(
      kmeans(
        x,
        centers   = k,
        nstart    = nstart,
        iter.max  = iter.max,
        algorithm = algorithm
      ),
      warning = function(w) {
        status[i] <<- "warning"
        notes[i]  <<- conditionMessage(w)
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      },
      error = function(e) {
        status[i] <<- "error"
        notes[i]  <<- conditionMessage(e)
        NULL
      }
    )

    runtime_sec[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

    if (is.null(km)) next

    models[[i]]   <- km
    wss[i]        <- km$tot.withinss

    sil           <- silhouette(km$cluster, dmat)
    sil_scores[i] <- mean(sil[, 3])

    ch_scores[i] <- intCriteria(
      traj = x,
      part = as.integer(km$cluster),
      crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
    )$calinski_harabasz
  }

  data.frame(
    Algorithm   = algorithm,
    k           = k_vals,
    WSS         = wss,
    Silhouette  = sil_scores,
    CH          = ch_scores,
    runtime_sec = runtime_sec,
    status      = status,
    notes       = notes
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(model_index = seq_along(k_vals)) |>
    list(metrics = _, models = models)
}

# Detect the elbow of the WSS curve using the maximum perpendicular distance
# from the line connecting the first and last points.
# Returns the elbow k and the distance of every k from that line.
find_elbow_k <- function(k, wss) {
  pts <- cbind(k, wss)
  p1  <- pts[1, ]
  p2  <- pts[nrow(pts), ]

  # Perpendicular distance from point p to the line defined by a and b
  point_line_distance <- function(p, a, b) {
    num <- abs((b[2] - a[2]) * p[1] - (b[1] - a[1]) * p[2] + b[1] * a[2] - b[2] * a[1])
    den <- sqrt((b[2] - a[2])^2 + (b[1] - a[1])^2)
    num / den
  }

  distances    <- apply(pts, 1, point_line_distance, a = p1, b = p2)
  elbow_index  <- which.max(distances)

  list(elbow_k = k[elbow_index], distances = distances)
}
```

# SELECT FINAL K
<!-- Choose final k from MacQueen results.
     Show all algorithms agree → emphasises robustness, not superiority.
     Strategy:
       • Use elbow method on WSS as the primary criterion
       • Use Silhouette and CH as supporting diagnostics
       • Check cluster size balance before finalising
       • Override k manually after inspecting results if needed -->

# 4. Loop over all embeddings
```{r loop}
# ── Outer loop: run all three algorithms for each embedding ──────────────────
for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }

  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")
  embedding_t0 <- Sys.time()

  # Load and z-score the embedding matrix; first column is UserID
  embeddings       <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  user_ids         <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embeddings[, -1]))
  embedding_tag    <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  # If a full cached result exists for this embedding, load and skip
  full_file <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache",
                         paste0("kmeans_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))

  if (file.exists(full_file)) {
    cat("Loading FULL cached result for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
    all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- readRDS(full_file)
    next
  }

  # Cache file paths (checked before running to allow partial re-use)
  kmeans_file <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("kmeans_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))
  all_file    <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_all_", embedding_tag, ".rds"))
  mq_file     <- file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_mq_",  embedding_tag, ".rds"))

  cat("Running k-means for:", embedding_tag, "\n")

  # Precompute distance matrix once; reused for all silhouette calls
  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  embedding_t0 <- Sys.time()

  # Evaluate all three algorithms across k_vals
  k_eval_hw    <- evaluate_kmeans(embedding_matrix, k_vals, dmat, "Hartigan-Wong")
  k_eval_lloyd <- evaluate_kmeans(embedding_matrix, k_vals, dmat, "Lloyd")
  k_eval_mq    <- evaluate_kmeans(embedding_matrix, k_vals, dmat, "MacQueen")

  k_results_hw    <- k_eval_hw$metrics
  k_results_lloyd <- k_eval_lloyd$metrics
  k_results_mq    <- k_eval_mq$metrics

  k_models_hw    <- k_eval_hw$models
  k_models_lloyd <- k_eval_lloyd$models
  k_models_mq    <- k_eval_mq$models

  # Combined metrics from all algorithms for multi-algorithm plots
  k_results_all <- bind_rows(k_results_hw, k_results_lloyd, k_results_mq)

  # Select best k from MacQueen metrics (used as the reference algorithm)
  best_k_sil   <- k_results_mq$k[which.max(k_results_mq$Silhouette)]
  best_k_ch    <- k_results_mq$k[which.max(k_results_mq$CH)]
  elbow_info   <- find_elbow_k(k_results_mq$k, k_results_mq$WSS)
  best_k_elbow <- elbow_info$elbow_k
  final_k      <- best_k_elbow  # elbow is the primary selection criterion

  # Re-fit final model with high nstart for robustness to random initialisation
  set.seed(123)
  kmeans_result <- kmeans(
    embedding_matrix,
    centers   = final_k,
    nstart    = 100,
    iter.max  = 100,
    algorithm = "MacQueen"
  )

  cluster_df    <- data.frame(UserID = user_ids, Cluster = kmeans_result$cluster)
  final_sil     <- silhouette(kmeans_result$cluster, dmat)
  final_avg_sil <- mean(final_sil[, 3])

  # PCA projection for visualisation
  pca           <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1     = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2     = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)
  )

  runtime_total_sec <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), embedding_t0, units = "secs"))
  cluster_sizes     <- table(cluster_df$Cluster)

  # Collect any warning/error messages from the evaluation runs
  notes_text <- NA_character_
  if ("notes" %in% names(k_results_all)) {
    tmp_notes <- unique(na.omit(k_results_all$notes))
    if (length(tmp_notes) > 0) notes_text <- paste(tmp_notes, collapse = " | ")
  }

  # One-row summary for cross-embedding and cross-method comparisons
  summary_row <- data.frame(
    method            = "kmeans",
    embedding         = embedding_tag,
    best_k            = final_k,
    best_q            = NA,   # not applicable for standard k-means
    silhouette        = final_avg_sil,
    CH                = k_results_mq$CH[which.max(k_results_mq$Silhouette)],
    prob_silh         = NA,
    cluster_size_min  = min(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_max  = max(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_sd   = sd(as.numeric(cluster_sizes)),
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    notes             = notes_text
  )

  # Store all artefacts for this embedding in the master list
  all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- list(
    embedding_path   = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag    = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids         = user_ids,
    dmat             = dmat,
    k_models_hw      = k_models_hw,
    k_models_lloyd   = k_models_lloyd,
    k_models_mq      = k_models_mq,
    k_results_hw     = k_results_hw,
    k_results_lloyd  = k_results_lloyd,
    k_results_mq     = k_results_mq,
    k_results_all    = k_results_all,
    best_k_sil       = best_k_sil,
    best_k_ch        = best_k_ch,
    best_k_elbow     = best_k_elbow,
    elbow_distances  = elbow_info$distances,
    final_k          = final_k,
    kmeans_result    = kmeans_result,
    cluster_df       = cluster_df,
    final_sil        = final_sil,
    final_avg_sil    = final_avg_sil,
    pca_df           = pca_df,
    var_explained    = var_explained,
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    summary_row      = summary_row,
    # Placeholder fields for optional stability analysis
    stability_info   = list(
      seeds_tested      = NA,
      n_runs            = NA,
      chosen_k_values   = NA,
      chosen_q_values   = NA,
      ari_mean          = NA,
      ari_sd            = NA,
      stability_notes   = NA_character_
    )
  )

  cat("Saved results for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
}
```

# 5. Show results for all embeddings
```{r results}
# Print a concise summary for each embedding: k selected by each criterion,
# final average silhouette, and raw cluster size distribution.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  cat("Best k by elbow:",      all_results[[name]]$best_k_elbow, "\n")
  cat("Best k by silhouette:", all_results[[name]]$best_k_sil,   "\n")
  cat("Best k by CH:",         all_results[[name]]$best_k_ch,    "\n")
  cat("Final average silhouette:", all_results[[name]]$final_avg_sil, "\n")
  cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
  print(table(all_results[[name]]$cluster_df$Cluster))
}
```

# 6. Plot tuning results for all embeddings
```{r plots}
# Three diagnostic plots per embedding: Silhouette, CH, and WSS with the
# elbow k marked by a dashed vertical line.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  # ── Silhouette by k (all algorithms) ────────────────────────────────────
  p1 <- ggplot(res$k_results_all, aes(x = k, y = Silhouette, color = Algorithm)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Silhouette by k -", name))

  print(p1)
  ggsave(file.path("output/kmeans_plots", paste0("silhouette_", name, ".png")),
         p1, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120)

  # ── Calinski-Harabasz by k (all algorithms) ──────────────────────────────
  p2 <- ggplot(res$k_results_all, aes(x = k, y = CH, color = Algorithm)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("CH by k -", name))

  print(p2)
  ggsave(file.path("output/kmeans_plots", paste0("ch_", name, ".png")),
         p2, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120)

  # ── WSS elbow plot with elbow k annotated ───────────────────────────────
  p3 <- ggplot(res$k_results_all, aes(x = k, y = WSS, color = Algorithm)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = res$best_k_elbow, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = res$best_k_elbow,
             y = max(res$k_results_all$WSS, na.rm = TRUE),
             label = paste("Elbow k =", res$best_k_elbow),
             vjust = -0.5, color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("WSS by k (Elbow Method) -", name))

  print(p3)
  ggsave(file.path("output/kmeans_plots", paste0("wss_", name, ".png")),
         p3, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120)
}
```

# 7. Plot PCA for all embeddings
```{r pca}
# Project each embedding's final cluster assignments onto the first two
# principal components, coloured by cluster. Axis labels show % variance.
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  p_pca <- ggplot(res$pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("K-Means Clusters (PCA Projection) -", name,
                    "k =", res$final_k),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[2], 1), "%)")
    )

  print(p_pca)
  ggsave(
    file.path("output/kmeans_plots", paste0("pca_", name, "_k", res$final_k, ".png")),
    p_pca, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 8. Choose best overall embedding
```{r choose}
# Collect the best-parameter row from every embedding and select the single
# best overall model: highest Silhouette at the elbow k, then highest CH max.
all_best <- lapply(all_results, function(res) {
  data.frame(
    embedding           = res$embedding_tag,
    best_k              = res$final_k,
    Elbow_k             = res$best_k_elbow,
    Silhouette_at_elbow = res$final_avg_sil,
    CH_max              = max(res$k_results_mq$CH, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})

all_best_df <- bind_rows(all_best)
print(all_best_df)

best_overall_index <- with(all_best_df, order(-Silhouette_at_elbow, -CH_max))[1]
best_overall       <- all_best_df[best_overall_index, ]
print(best_overall)

# Pull full result for the winning embedding for use in downstream notebooks
best_name       <- best_overall$embedding
best_res        <- all_results[[best_name]]
best_kmeans     <- best_res$kmeans_result
best_cluster_df <- best_res$cluster_df
best_pca_df     <- best_res$pca_df
best_final_k    <- best_res$final_k
```

# 9. Save per-embedding results
```{r save}
# Persist all artefacts for downstream use and reproducibility:
#   • cluster assignment CSVs        (UserID → Cluster)
#   • k-selection metric CSVs        (all algorithms, all k values)
#   • serialised model objects       (kmeans_result, k_models_*)
#   • serialised full result         (complete result list for reloading)

for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  # Cluster assignments for this embedding's final model
  write.csv(
    res$cluster_df,
    file      = file.path("output/kmeans_results",
                          paste0("kmeans_clusters_", name, "_k", res$final_k, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Combined metrics from all three algorithms
  write.csv(
    res$k_results_all,
    file      = file.path("output/kmeans_results",
                          paste0("kmeans_k_selection_metrics_all_", name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # MacQueen-only metrics (used as the reference for k selection)
  write.csv(
    res$k_results_mq,
    file      = file.path("output/kmeans_results",
                          paste0("kmeans_k_selection_metrics_macqueen_", name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # One-row-per-embedding summary table (written inside the loop;
  # the final write after the loop overwrites with the complete table)
  all_summary_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_results, function(x) x$summary_row))
  write.csv(
    all_summary_df,
    file      = file.path("output/kmeans_results", "kmeans_summary_table.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Serialised final k-means model object
  saveRDS(
    res$kmeans_result,
    file = file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("kmeans_result_", name, ".rds"))
  )

  # Serialised combined metrics for all algorithms
  saveRDS(
    res$k_results_all,
    file = file.path("output/kmeans_cache", paste0("k_results_all_", name, ".rds"))
  )

  # Serialised per-algorithm model lists
  saveRDS(k_models_hw,
          file = file.path("output/kmeans_cache",
                           paste0("k_models_hw_", embedding_tag, ".rds")))
  saveRDS(k_models_lloyd,
          file = file.path("output/kmeans_cache",
                           paste0("k_models_lloyd_", embedding_tag, ".rds")))
  saveRDS(k_models_mq,
          file = file.path("output/kmeans_cache",
                           paste0("k_models_mq_", embedding_tag, ".rds")))

  # Serialised full result list (used by comparison notebooks without re-fitting)
  saveRDS(res,
          file = file.path("output/kmeans_cache",
                           paste0("kmeans_full_result_", name, ".rds")))
}

# Final complete summary table across all embeddings
all_summary_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_results, function(x) x$summary_row))
```
